entries.desc: abi version gate; returns 2 — the module imports the abi=2 cam family only (cam_frame_get carries w/h out with the frame; zero retired camera_* names in the import table)
linear-memory offset for the host-written msgpack args; 0 = refusal; <=128B calls reuse one fixed slot (§3.1)

one cam_frame_get into the module frame buffer; geometry rides the call (no separate info call). off = linear offset of the RGB565 frame (hi byte first — the GC2145 DVP wire order). Defensive {error='bad frame geometry'} only; real host refusals (camera off, frame over cap) raise rt.

re-encode the LAST grabbed frame through the vendored encoder (per-scanline RGB565->RGB888, H2V2, quality default 80 clamped 1..100 — the frame2jpg semantics). {error='no frame (grab first)'} before any grab; {error='encode failed (output overflow?)'} beyond the 128KB output buffer.

entries.signature: [{quality=i:1..100}?] -> {len, w, h, enc_ms} + one ch=2 JPEG frame | {error,...}
entries.desc: the full pipeline: cam_frame_get -> jpge encode (enc_ms spans the encode ONLY — the honest interp cost, sensor read excluded) -> SOI/EOI gate (FFD8/FFD9 first/last) -> stream_send (ch=2, host stamps 'jpge'). The host chunks payloads at 65,526-5B name stamp = 65,521B — VGA JPEGs are multi-chunk shapes. HONEST interp risk (measured): VGA q80 ~15s+, QVGA q60 ~3.9s vs the 5s VM-task TWDT single-call bar — VGA shots WILL trip the watchdog on the interpreter; QVGA q<=60 is the measured interp-safe class. Single call by design; the AOT track is the resolution, NOT slice APIs. Truncation (TX full/OOM mid-chunk) answers {error='stream_send truncated', len, sent, w, h, enc_ms} — sent is a whole-chunk multiple prefix.

entries.signature: [] -> {len, w, h} + one ch=2 raw RGB565 frame | {error,...}
entries.desc: the generic CV egress: one cam_frame_get + one stream_send of the RAW RGB565 frame (len = w*h*2; no encode, no JPEG). VGA raw = 614,400B = 10 host chunks; truncation answers {error='stream_send truncated', len, sent, w, h} (no enc_ms — nothing was encoded). Natively tested against a chunk-emulating sink (wire byte-equality + chunk counts + mid-chunk TX-full).

linear_memory.note: 14 pages: VGA frame 614.4KB + JPEG out 128KB + encoder MCU pool 30.7KB + scanline 1.9KB + heap/args/out + wasm-ld 64KB stack. Static allocation only — WAMR builtin malloc unavailable (heap_size=0); the encoder's single allocation (MCU line pool) is a fixed arena, high-water 15,360B QVGA / 30,720B VGA, asserted natively (T09).

hardware.consumes: the bench camera stream (GC2145 DVP epoch; RGB565 hi-byte-first, QVGA 320x240 / VGA 640x480); bring-up is gc2145@1.0.0's job — this module claims no hardware of its own
hardware.egress: stream ch=2 frames host-stamped 'jpge' (JPEG for shot, raw RGB565 for stream_raw)
hardware.encoder_provenance: vendored from espressif/esp32-camera 2.1.8 jpge (Apache-2.0; public upstream) — byte-identical conversion/subsampling/quality semantics to the board's former native frame2jpg path

auxiliary.note: wamrc xtensa/esp32s3 output, hash-recorded for provenance. NOT deployable on the current board stack (loader honestly refuses .aot execution — upstream ESP32-S3 AOT-in-PSRAM defect). Future-ready (the documented interp TWDT resolution); never listed in index.json files[].
